articles.title: The Tiny Fossil That Fooled Scientists for Nearly 30 Years
articles.summary: Lizzie looked like an early reptile, but X-ray scans show it lived in water, with gills and a fish-like mouth.

articles.title: Secret Lakes Under the Red Sea Are Full of Tiny Life
articles.summary: Scientists found super-salty lakes under the Red Sea where tiny microbes live without oxygen. The lakes also hold clues about old tsunamis.

articles.title: How 100 Starlings Took Over a Whole Continent
articles.summary: About 100 starlings set free in Central Park grew into 200 million birds, and studying their small differences helps scientists understand fast evolution.
